name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.SidePairing.scaledCupBounds_sparse_thick
summary: Cuts are the letters with no thick letter in the next J steps; by sparseness every letter has a cut within 2J + 1 steps before it; a thick letter at offset a < n before i (n the distance to the nearest previous cut) has a = 0 or a + J + 1 = n, and both offsets can occur; either every offset passes the sign/width test against t = 0 (the sign alternative) or a failing offset t gives the long-gap alternative of scaledCupBounds_of_cut_windows.

steps.claim: Let C(i): no thick letter T among σ^t(i), 1 ≤ t ≤ J.
steps.lean: let C i := ∀ t ≥ 1, t ≤ J → ¬T ((k.letterFrob ^ t) i)

steps.claim: If C fails at σ^{−a}(i) and T(σ^{−a}(i)), then C holds at σ^{−(a+J+1)}(i) (from hth).
steps.lean:
replace hth i a (c : ¬C (.stepBack i a)) (t : T (i.stepBack a)) : C (i.stepBack (a + J.succ)) :=
    fun n _ hn tn ↦ c (by simp at t; simpa [t, pow_add, add_comm (_ - _), pow_sub _ hn.step] using
    (hth _ (J.succ - n) (by simp; lia) · · tn))

steps.claim: Apply scaledCupBounds_of_cut_windows with cut = C, s = 0, b, n = 2W, J, s₀ = ⌊3b/5⌋, G' = 2W: every letter has a cut within 2J + 1 steps (by contradiction with step 2); the main condition H remains for each i, n.
steps.lean:
apply h.scaledCupBounds_of_cut_windows _ (fun _ ↦ 0) b (2 * W) _ (3 * b / 5) (2 * W) hW hU _ .refl
    hδ h₈ hη _ _ _
    (by grw [← ·]; grind) _ _ (by_contra fun h ↦ h ⟨J + 1, by grind, fun n _ hn t ↦ h ⟨_, by grind,
    hth · (J + 1 - n) (h ⟨_, by simp; lia, ·⟩) (by simpa [pow_sub _ hn.step])⟩⟩) fun i n hl h ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Six numeric hypotheses (hX, hκ, hs, hy, hK, hz) follow from the size conditions.

For 0 ≤ a < n (n > 0 the distance from i back to the nearest cut σ^{−n}(i)) with T(σ^{−a}(i)): a = 0 or a + J + 1 = n. For 0 < a: σ^{−a}(i) is not a cut (minimality of n), so step 2 makes σ^{−(a+J+1)}(i) a cut, whence a + J + 1 ≥ n; and the cut at σ^{−n}(i) has no thick letter among the next J letters, so n − a > J, i.e. a + J + 1 ≤ n. Both offsets can occur (e.g. J = 1, n = 3, thick letters at offsets 0 and 1 with the adjacent outer letters thin).
steps.lean:
replace hth a ha t := (eq_zero_or_pos a).imp_right fun a₀ ↦ (not_lt.1 fun e ↦ hl (n - a) (by lia)
    (by lia) (by simpa [← pow_mul_pow_sub _ ha.le])).eq_of_not_lt (h _ ⟨by lia, ·⟩
    (hth i a (h a ⟨a₀, ha⟩) t))

steps.claim: Either every a < n has ε(σ^{−a}i) = ε(i) or β(σ^{−a}i) + V ≤ η — then t = 0 and the first (sign) alternative holds; constant signs satisfy it even when thick letters are present —, or some a < n fails this test, and then t = a gives the second (long-gap) alternative: σ^{−t}(i) is thick (β + V > η ≥ G + V forces β = b), t > 0 (the test passes at a = 0), so t + J + 1 = n by step 5, and the needed inequality s₀ + G·Σ_{a≤J}p^a < b follows from hb and the geometric sum bound (Nat.geomSum_lt).
